question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 E 组：厄瓜多尔 vs 库拉索（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group E: Ecuador vs Curaçao (three-way 90-minute result)
one_liner_cn: Elo 差 504 分的悬殊对决：厄瓜多尔全主力且状态火热，库拉索赛前两度换帅，厄瓜多尔约 84% 取胜，悬念在比分而非胜负。
one_liner_en: A 504-point Elo mismatch: full-strength, in-form Ecuador against a Curaçao side rattled by two pre-tournament coaching changes — roughly 84% for Ecuador, with the margin the real question.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 504 分（1938 vs 1434，世界第 9 对第 91），Davidson 统计模型基础胜率即 82%。
key_reasons.en: A 504-point Elo gap (1938 vs 1434, world No. 9 vs No. 91); the Davidson statistical model alone gives Ecuador 82%.

key_reasons.cn: 厄瓜多尔全主力出战（凯塞多、帕乔领衔，无伤病报告），预选赛南美第 2 不败收官，热身 2-1 胜沙特。
key_reasons.en: Ecuador is at full strength (Caicedo and Pacho headline, no reported injuries), finished CONMEBOL qualifying 2nd and unbeaten, and beat Saudi Arabia 2-1 in their final friendlies window.

key_reasons.cn: 库拉索为史上人口最少参赛国，赛前 4 个月内两度换帅（阿德沃卡特辞职、吕滕辞职、阿德沃卡特回归），备战连续性受损。
key_reasons.en: Curaçao, the smallest nation ever at a World Cup, went through two coaching changes in four months (Advocaat resigned, Rutten stepped down, Advocaat returned), disrupting preparation continuity.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat 0.820/0.135/0.045; bounded evidence adjustment of +2.0/-1.5/-0.5 pp (cap ±8pp) for Ecuador's form/full squad vs Curaçao's coaching turmoil yields p_final 0.84/0.12/0.04. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 and ±25 Elo sensitivity plus debutant data thinness. No betting-market inputs of any kind.
